name: Noah Reiner
source:
Noah is a happy-go-lucky graffiti artist and gamer who spends his time painting murals or playing at the gaming cafe!

He's been caught a few times in the middle of his work, but that doesn't stop him from trying again! Noah wants to exchange others with his art, even if it means getting in trouble!
